content.short: Suilend is the leading lending protocol on Sui, developed by the Solend team to optimize capital efficiency.
content.description: Suilend is the definitive decentralized money market built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide a professional-grade borrowing and lending experience. Developed by the expert team behind Solana's Solend (Save), the platform focuses on institutional-grade security and maximum capital efficiency. Users can supply various digital assets to earn interest or borrow against them with sub-second finality, leveraging the high throughput and safety of Sui's Move programming language. Deeply integrated with the Sui ecosystem, Suilend features innovative products like 'SpringSui'.
content.meta: Suilend offers decentralized lending and borrowing on Sui with high capital efficiency. Discover Suilend on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
